The method is presented as a simpler alternative to full Dual Contouring, omitting the QEF minimization step [S1, unofficial].

The evidence explicitly states that the method is a 'simplified isosurface extraction method' that 'places a single vertex at the center of every voxel cell' based on sign changes. Standard Dual Contouring involves minimizing a Quadratic Error Function (QEF) to determine the optimal vertex position within a cell to preserve features. The evidence shows that this implementation simply returns the center of the voxel (`[x as f32 + 0.5, y as f32 + 0.5, z as f32 + 0.5]`) if a sign change is detected, thereby omitting the QEF minimization step. The source also labels the implementation as 'Unfinished: Dual Contouring' and an 'attempt at general purpose dual-contouring', supporting the claim that it is presented as a simpler alternative.
